text:
Title is in the friend. The gift over to "the children of my sister who reach the age of 25" is an executory interest that depends on the lot someday being used for church purposes. That event could happen at any time, even after any life in being plus 21 years, so the interest violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and is void. With the gift over struck, the friend's defeasible fee becomes a fee simple absolute.

CONFIDENCE: 88
